topic.title: Platform User Roles
topic.shortdesc: Platform user roles define a user's primary role and available functionality in .

body.p: Three platform user roles are available: Subject-Matter Expert, Contributor, and Author.
A platform user role (license) identifies a user's primary role in . It is distinct from roles scoped to an organization, a project, or review task.
Each role includes all the capabilities of the previous role. Therefore, a Contributor can do everything a Subject-Matter Expert can do, and an Author can do everything a Contributor can do.

section.title: Subject-Matter Expert
section.p: This is the default platform user role.
Users with this role have access only to review functionality. They can:

li.p: Access review tasks assigned to them.
Read the documents included in review tasks.

ul.li: Create and manage independent (not project-related) review tasks.

section.p: Subject-Matter Experts do not have access to project functionality.

section.title: Contributor
section.p: This intermediate platform user role is intended for users who need access to project content for proposing changes but do not need project creation or management capabilities.

A Contributor is assigned to a project with the Collaborator project role by the project management team. This is the only project role available to Contributors. In addition to what Subject-Matter Experts can do, they can:

li.p: Access the projects that they are assigned to and read the project content.
Edit project files in a personal workspace.

ul.li: Suggest changes to the project team via review tasks.

section.p: Contributors cannot commit changes to a project, integrate review tasks, publish deliverables, or manage projects.

section.title: Author
section.p: This is the advanced platform user role intended for users who need access to projects, with the level of access determined by the assigned project role. Users with this role can be assigned the Collaborator project role (private projects only), Maintainer project role, or Owner project role.
An Author with the Collaborator project role has the same capabilities as a Contributor.
In addition, an Author with a Maintainer project role or Owner project role can do the following:

li.p: Create and manage project review tasks.

body.p: Each platform user role is associated with a license type. provides license packages that specify the licenses available to Subject-Matter Experts, Contributors, and Authors.
Platform user roles are assigned in the Users Management tab of the Administration Pageby an organization administrator in the Organization Members Page.
